name: acsi-agentskills
description: Reusable agent skills, packaged as Claude Code plugins grouped by audience (coding or not) and runtime (anywhere or local).

plugins.name: acsi-anything-anywhere
plugins.description: Skills for any Claude surface, coding or not: the claude.ai web and iOS apps, Claude in Chrome, the Claude Desktop app, and Claude Code.

plugins.name: acsi-coding-anywhere
plugins.description: Coding skills for Claude Code terminals and Claude Code cloud sessions.

plugins.name: acsi-coding-local
plugins.description: Machine-bound coding skills and hooks for Claude Code on your own machines (WSL and Windows homes): clone sync and the API-credit lane.

plugins.name: acsi-non-coding-local
plugins.description: Non-coding skills that need local files or a signed-in browser, for the Claude Desktop app's local Cowork.

plugins.name: example-site-platform
plugins.description: An example of a federated plugin: the skills of a separate platform repo, served from that repo rather than mirrored here. Point it at a repo of your own, or remove the entry.
